apiVersion.description: The release file's apiVersion, passed as the service's optional values file while app-delivery is on (ADR 0166). Without a release file none of these keys is set.

autoscaling.description: Set by the golden-path ApplicationSet while autoscaling-defaults is on (ADR 0047). With it on, each Deployment renders no replica count and a CPU HorizontalPodAutoscaler.

signin.description: Set by the golden-path ApplicationSet only while golden-path-signin is on (issue 1746). With it on, the BFF gets its sign-in variables and the workload renders its Keycloak client; the redirect URI is the ingress host, so ingress is required.

safetyDefaults.description: Set by the golden-path ApplicationSet only while golden-path-safety-defaults is on (ADR 0154). Then each workload renders the safety defaults; off, every render is unchanged.

rolloutDefaults.description: The numbers of the safety defaults, rendered only while safetyDefaults is on (ADR 0154).

ingress.description: Set by the ApplicationSet from the Service's default host (ADR 0042); without it no ingress resource renders.

sharedGateway.description: Set by the ApplicationSet only while platform-shared-gateway is on (ADR 0133): the shared platform Gateway and the organization's domain its wildcard listener serves. A host under that domain also gets a route on it; any other host does not.

domain.description: The platform organization's domain, <organizationId>.<platformDomain>, which the shared Gateway's wildcard listener serves.

image.description: An image reference that carries its sha256 digest; a tag alone is refused.

release.description: The spec of <service>.release.json (ADR 0166). A component's digest replaces the digest of its template image; a component with no release digest keeps its lock image. kore validate enforces that rejected never holds the component's own digest (ADR 0172).
